subject: Fix rdb pipe uninitialized false positive warning (#800)
reason: The change only initializes two local variables (rdb_pipe_write, safe_to_exit_pipe) to 0 in rdbSaveToReplicasSockets to silence a false-positive 'may be used uninitialized' compiler warning. Every read or close of those variables is guarded by !dual_channel, the same path that assigns them from anetPipe before use, so the initializer value is never consumed on any path. This is a build-warning fix with no behavior change: no reply, replication, or persistence semantics differ between the builds, so no scenario can reach or observe the change.
